_description: Contract schema for Rise FC schema operator controller decision records. Applies to Prompt 03 (initial controller decision) and Prompt 14 (post-analyzer controller decision). This is a contract definition only — not a real run artifact.

decisionDescriptions.ACCEPT: Draft passes all checks. No blocking defects. Proceed to next governed step.
decisionDescriptions.MODIFY: Draft has non-blocking issues requiring targeted correction. Specify exact modifications. Re-confirm before proceeding.
decisionDescriptions.REJECT: Draft has a blocking defect. Draft is discarded. Return to Prompt 01 for regeneration.
decisionDescriptions.DEFER: Run cannot proceed due to an external condition. Suspend and document blocking condition.
decisionDescriptions.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Ambiguity or edge case requires package owner judgment. Escalate before proceeding.
decisionDescriptions.PATCH_REQUIRED: Specific targeted defect found that can be corrected without full regeneration. Document patch, apply, and re-run affected review steps. (Prompt 14 only)

runId.description: Run identifier this decision belongs to.

promptSource.description: Which prompt issued this controller decision.

decisionDate.description: ISO 8601 date of the controller decision.

priorQaResult.description: QA result received from Prompt 02 before this decision.

selfApprovalAttempted.description: Whether self-approval was attempted. Must always be false.

productionAuthorizationGranted.description: Whether this decision grants production authorization. Must always be false — production requires human approval.

modificationsRequired.description: List of exact modifications required when decision is MODIFY.

defectAndStopCode.description: Defect description and applicable stop code when decision is REJECT.

blockingCondition.description: Description of the external condition blocking the run.

ambiguityDescription.description: Description of the ambiguity requiring owner judgment.

patchSpecification.description: Exact patch specification when decision is PATCH_REQUIRED. Prompt 14 only.

analyzerIssuesReviewed.description: List of analyzer WARN or DISAGREE items reviewed by the controller in Prompt 14.
